summary: Published PMO chronology and subsequent Israeli television reporting place Netanyahu's initial alert at 06:29 on October 7 and the first full situational assessment with the defense minister and senior security chiefs at 09:55, while differing over his departure/arrival chronology and the extent of direct contact with security chiefs before the Kirya.
notes: Fresh recheck located no official or judicial finding assigning Netanyahu individual responsibility for the operational timing. The PMO account preserves earlier military-secretary updates and 06:44 questions/instructions; other Israeli reporting disputes parts of the transit/contact chronology. Preserve Pending and the competing chronology without inferring motive or converting a timing dispute into a management-failure finding absent a direct responsibility predicate. Distinct from canonical LEAD-2026-0002 concerning a later deliberate-withholding statement.
